description: Voronoi-partition a polygon into cells — a pure CALCULATION node: coordinates in, coordinates out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes a polygon as a coordinate LIST and returns its Voronoi cells as a coordinate list. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas — wire val-polygons into a Polygon node when you want the cells drawn.

INPUT: polygon takes the outline as JSON [[x,y],...] metre pairs, local to the anchor. Wire Space Geometry val-points into valin-polygon.

OUTPUT: val-polygons publishes every cell as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list, which a Polygon node accepts directly.

SEEDS: the polygon vertices (useVertices on -> one cell per vertex) or seeds random interior points (off). metric = Euclidean / Manhattan / Chebyshev. relax runs Lloyd/CVT relaxation; rectilinear produces BSP-like axis-aligned cells (concave-safe). Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
